bad.title: One prompt, straight to code
bad.text: The agent decides where pins are saved on its own, and nobody sees that choice.

bad.title: 14 files and 900 lines, then review
bad.text: The first chance to question its choices comes after the code exists.
bad.wait: Press Build it to see this.

bad.title: The wrong guess costs 900 lines
bad.text: Pins saved in one browser vanish on another computer, so most of the code changes.
bad.wait: Press Build it, then Review, to see this.

good.title: A plan before any code
good.text: Four short steps to read, and nothing is built yet.

good.title: The wrong step shows in the plan
good.text: “Save pins in this browser” fails anyone who uses two computers.
good.wait: Press Ask for a plan to see this.

good.title: Fixed with one sentence
good.text: Pins move to the account before a line is written, so no code is thrown away.
good.wait: Press Ask for a plan, Change, then Approve plan to see this.

bad.title: Four layers, none usable alone
bad.text: An index, a server and a results list do nothing until the search box lands.

bad.title: Nothing to try for three steps
bad.text: Each landed step says the same thing, so a problem can hide in any of them.

bad.title: Everything at once, and “dark” finds nothing
bad.text: Dark mode is right there, but nobody knows which of four steps broke it.
bad.wait: Press Land next step four times to see this.

good.title: Each step is something to try
good.text: Search by name, jump, match descriptions, then the empty result.

good.title: Something to try after step 1
good.text: Typing “dark” already narrows the list to Dark mode.
good.wait: Press Land next step to see this.

good.title: Even no match is its own step
good.text: “xyz” gets “Try a shorter word.”, tested on its own.
good.wait: Press Land next step four times to see this.

bad.title: No check next to any step
bad.text: Four steps, and nothing says how each one will be proven to work.

bad.title: “Done” on a broken step
bad.text: The agent said done, but double-click does nothing on the active tab.
bad.wait: Run all four steps, then press Try it yourself to see this.

bad.title: Two more steps on top of it
bad.text: Steps 3 and 4 were built on the break, so they need checking again too.
bad.wait: Run all four steps, then press Try it yourself to see this.

good.title: A check written next to each step
good.text: Unit test, end-to-end spec or screenshot, picked before the agent starts.

good.title: Step 2 fails its spec first
good.text: The active tab ignored double-click, so the agent fixed it before step 3.
good.wait: Press Run next step twice to see this.

good.title: Done means the check passed
good.text: All four pass, so step 3 builds on a step 2 that works.
good.wait: Run all four steps to see this.

bad.title: An open question, and work goes on
bad.text: Nobody knows yet if palettes belong to one person or the whole team.

bad.title: Start step 2 works anyway
bad.text: Nothing stops the next step while step 1 is still in review.

bad.title: Built for one person, then redone
bad.text: The answer comes late, and steps 2 and 3 guessed wrong.
bad.wait: Start steps 2 and 3, then answer the question to see this.

good.title: The same open question
good.text: Steps 2 and 3 depend on whether palettes are personal or shared.

good.title: Start step 2 is off until then
good.text: The line under it says what it’s waiting for.

good.title: Built for the team, once
good.text: Step 2 starts after the answer, so nothing has to be redone.
good.wait: Answer the question, then start step 2 to see this.

bad.title: “All tests pass” with nothing behind it
bad.text: No test names, no count, no output to read.

bad.title: The test file was empty
bad.text: Export breaks a week later, and no test ever touched it.

good.title: The output comes before Approve
good.text: Approve isn’t even offered until the test run is on screen.

good.title: Green, with 0 tests
good.text: vitest says 1 file passed, and that file has no tests in it.
good.wait: Press Show the test output to see this.

good.title: Three real tests, seen running
good.text: Three tests for image size, see-through background and file name.
good.wait: Press Show the test output, then Ask for real tests, to see this.

bad.title: 48 unit tests, no screen
bad.text: None of them can see where the Share button is.

bad.title: Share ends up in the ••• menu
bad.text: People can’t find it after release, and nothing flagged the move.

good.title: The spec fails on the change
good.text: share.spec.ts can’t find the Share button, while all 48 unit tests pass.

good.title: After: no Share in the toolbar
good.text: Only Undo, Redo and ••• are left. The screenshot shows what the spec found.

good.title: The rerun proves the fix
good.text: Share is back, and the spec passes before anyone approves.
good.wait: Press Fix and rerun to see this.

bad.title: Light, wide, and nothing else
bad.text: The easiest case to get right is the only one anyone looked at.

bad.title: “Unsaved” looks fine here
bad.text: Its color is fixed, so it vanishes in dark mode. This shot can’t show that.

good.title: Four cases instead of one
good.text: Three of them show a problem the light, wide shot hides.

good.title: Dark mode: “Unsaved” disappears
good.text: The fixed dark gray label sits on a dark card.
good.wait: Press Dark · wide to see this.

good.title: A count of what’s left to see
good.text: It stays at 0 of 3 until someone opens the other screenshots.

bad.title: Four green checks, one missing case
bad.text: None of them deletes two photos in a row.

bad.title: Found by people, a week late
bad.text: Undo brought back only one of two deleted photos.

good.title: The same four green checks
good.text: They pass here too, so they aren’t a reason to skip trying it.

good.title: The real Photos screen to try
good.text: A few minutes of deleting and undoing, the way people will.

good.title: The second Undo does nothing
good.text: The first photo is gone for good. No test deleted two in a row.
good.wait: Delete two photos, then press Undo twice to see this.

bad.title: Shipped as the agent wrote it
bad.text: No list of choices, so every default goes out without anyone picking it.

bad.title: “Are you sure?” names nobody
bad.text: It doesn’t say Ana, or that she loses the team’s files.
bad.wait: Press Remove next to Ana to see this.

bad.title: OK doesn’t say what happens
bad.text: People can’t tell from the button that it removes someone.
bad.wait: Press Remove next to Ana to see this.

good.title: Every visible choice, listed
good.text: Title, text and button, each with Keep or Change.

good.title: “Remove Ana from the team?”
good.text: The title names the person, and the text says she can be invited again.
good.wait: Press Change on each choice, then Remove, to see this.

good.title: Remove Ana instead of OK
good.text: The button says exactly what pressing it does.
good.wait: Press Change on each choice, then Remove, to see this.

bad.title: A font change in the file list
bad.text: Sidebar.css goes from 14px to 12px, and the description never says so.

bad.title: Smaller text on every page
bad.text: The sidebar shrinks everywhere, and nobody reviewed it.

good.title: Flagged as not part of this change
good.text: The same 14px → 12px line, marked so reviewers can’t miss it.

good.title: Its own pull request, its own note
good.text: “Smaller sidebar text” says why, with screenshots from before and after.
good.wait: Press Move to its own pull request to see this.

bad.title: A title about the code
bad.text: “Notification settings refactor” says nothing about the emails people get.

bad.title: Four lines of files and fields
bad.text: Reviewers must work out from emailOnMention that a switch is gone.

good.title: A title about what people get
good.text: Teammates know the change from the title alone.

good.title: Three lines in people’s words
good.text: The switch is gone, and old settings keep working until people choose.

good.title: Code notes come last
good.text: The split and the migration are still there, for the people who need them.

bad.title: “No visible change,” unchecked
bad.text: No screenshots back it up, so reviewers take it on trust.

bad.title: Shorter buttons and a new color
bad.text: People see a different Export button, and nobody was told.

good.title: Before and After, one click apart
good.text: Comparing the two takes seconds, before anyone approves.

good.title: The buttons did change
good.text: Cancel and Export are 4px shorter, and Export takes the shared color.

good.title: The claim is corrected
good.text: The description now lists the change, so reviewers can decide on it.
